main.description: Re-count vertex_spatial rows per (source_did, label) and write the result back into vertex_maps_coverage_target.collected_count. Closes the feedback loop so view_maps_coverage_gap_ranked reflects real graph state, not seed zeros. Called by orgs/etzhayyim/com-etzhayyim-maps/wire/bpmn/maps/refreshCoverageStats.bpmn every 15 minutes.

sourceDid.description: Optional filter: refresh only this source DID

label.description: Optional filter: refresh only this label

onlyZeroed.description: Refresh only rows where collected_count = 0 (fast path on steady state)

scanned.description: Number of (source_did, label) pairs aggregated from vertex_spatial

updated.description: Number of target rows whose collected_count actually changed

deltas.description: Top 20 non-zero-delta rows, sorted by |delta| desc
